settings.text: Four formulas each to cleanse, treat, hydrate and restore. Nothing beyond that.

settings.text: Plants are picked by hand at dawn and distilled in copper within 72 hours.

settings.text: Corsica, Morocco, the Horn of Africa and Grasse, from the same growers every year.

settings.title: Synthetic fragrance
settings.text: No silicones, parabens, phthalates or artificial colour in any formula.

settings.story: Its golden heads never wither after picking. We distil them the same afternoon, on the island.
Steam turns its oil a startling indigo — a sign of chamazulene, the compound skin finds so calming.
Gathered by cooperatives who have tapped the same trees for generations. Fair price, set in advance.
One tonne of blossom gives one litre of hydrosol. Distilled in copper within hours of picking.

settings.question: Are Verenne formulas suitable for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: Every formula is fragrance-free of synthetic perfume and patch-tested. Sève Dorée and Baume Résineux were designed with reactive skin in mind. As with any new product, patch test first.

settings.question: How long does a bottle last?
settings.answer: Used daily, a 30 ml serum lasts roughly 10–12 weeks. Mist and lotion around 8 weeks. Balm, a full season.

settings.question: Do you ship worldwide?
settings.answer: Yes — carbon-neutral delivery to 40+ countries. Free on orders over $150.

settings.question: Can I return an opened product?
settings.answer: Within 30 days, opened or not. We would rather you find the right ritual than keep the wrong one.
